claim.quote: A new exclusion plot has been derived for WIMP-nucleon spin-independent interaction. To obtain this result, 30 days of data from one IGEX detector, which has an energy threshold of ~4 keV, have been considered.

name: New constraints on WIMPs from the Canfranc IGEX dark matter search

summary.plain: First dark matter limit from an IGEX germanium detector at Canfranc: dark matter particles with masses near 50 GeV are ruled out at interaction strengths above the curve.
summary.technical: Spin-independent WIMP-nucleon exclusion plot from 30 days of data of one IGEX detector (~4 keV threshold) that improves other germanium-diode limits around 50 GeV; an additional 1 kg yr with a moderately lower background would test the DAMA region.

title: New constraints on WIMPs from the Canfranc IGEX dark matter search
why_it_matters: Showed that detectors built for double-beta decay could also test the DAMA region.
